async def act(page):
    # Click the link for the a11yproject repo to navigate to its project details page
    # Use the heading to locate the link within it, and wait for it to be clickable
    project_link = page.get_by_role("heading", name="The A11Y Project / a11yproject.com").get_by_role("link")
    await project_link.wait_for(state="visible")
    await project_link.wait_for(state="enabled")
    await project_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
